dedupe_keys.name: agricultural water use package for the modflow 6 api mf6api ag usgs

description: A Python package that simulates irrigated agriculture in MODFLOW 6 groundwater models through the MODFLOW application programming interface. The README says its ModflowApiAg class overrides the MODFLOW 6 water mover package and calculates irrigation demand from potential and actual evapotranspiration in the soil zone, with wells, streams (SFR), multi-aquifer wells and lakes as supported water sources and the unsaturated zone package (UZF) as the receiver. It needs Python 3.8 or later, flopy, modflowapi, numpy and pandas and runs on Windows, Linux and macOS, with a quickstart and example problems. The USGS software release is dated 2023, and the method is described in Larsen, Langevin, Hughes and Niswonger (2023) in Groundwater. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): Unlicense. Access is free of charge. Coverage is any MODFLOW 6 model. Caveats: the repository shows no activity after September 2023. For simulation it links farm irrigation demand to groundwater and stream depletion, so drought scenarios can show how pumping for crops draws down wells and rivers that towns and power plants also use. A related catalogue record is the USGS Water Data APIs.
